llm.summary: This skill mostly does what it says, but its configurable prompts can be executed through a shell, creating a real local command-injection risk.

dimensions.detail: Using the OpenClaw workspace, an API key for Volcengine, network-capable image generation, and an images output directory fits the purpose. The shell invocation makes that environment access overbroad because configurable prompt text can affect local command execution.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: No install hooks, dependency scripts, remote payload retrieval, or package-install side effects were found in the inspected artifacts; package.json declares no runtime dependencies and points to scripts/selfie.js as the main entry.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: The documentation discloses the image-generation purpose, ARK_API_KEY requirement, output directory, CLI usage, custom scenes, and optional heartbeat/message integration. The heartbeat-send workflow is user-directed documentation rather than installed automatic behavior, but users should understand it may trigger external API calls and onward image sending.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: The skill does not install services, scheduled tasks, hooks, memory rules, or cross-session persistence. It writes generated images under ~/.openclaw/workspace/images and may be called repeatedly if a user wires it into a heartbeat workflow.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

dimensions.detail: The stated purpose is coherent: generate cat selfies using a Volcengine image-generation skill and save them locally. The concern is that scene prompts from config/scenes.json are interpolated into an execSync shell command in scripts/selfie.js, so a malicious or badly formed custom scene can run unintended local commands.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

llm.guidance: Review this skill before installing. Do not use custom scene prompts from untrusted sources unless the shell invocation is fixed to use argument-array execution such as execFileSync or spawnSync. If you enable heartbeat sending, add explicit confirmation or rate limits and make sure the shared images directory cannot cause unintended images to be sent.
llm.findings:
[SDI-2] unexpected: Accepted as a material concern: scripts/selfie.js builds a shell command from a scene prompt loaded from config/scenes.json, and the docs explicitly support adding custom prompts.
[T09] unexpected: Accepted for the command-injection finding because execSync(command) runs through a shell with user-account privileges; this is an unsafe coding practice, not evidence of malicious intent.
[T09] unexpected: Accepted as a lesser integrity concern for selecting the newest PNG/JPG from a shared images directory; this could send the wrong image in the documented message workflow if unrelated files are present.
[SQP-2] expected: Downgraded: the docs disclose Volcengine image generation, API key setup, network troubleshooting, and message-tool sending, but they could more clearly warn about automated heartbeat costs and onward transmission.
[SQP-3] expected: Downgraded for security verdict purposes: the Chinese-only README, SKILL.md, package description, runtime messages, and scene text are a usability/localization issue, not hidden or purpose-mismatched behavior.
